questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):
1. It was launched in August 2014 as a national mission for financial inclusion.
2. Accounts opened under it come with a RuPay debit card carrying accident insurance cover.
3. The overdraft facility available on these accounts is up to Rs 50,000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMJDY (28 August 2014) offers basic zero-balance accounts with a RuPay card and accident cover. The overdraft facility is up to Rs 10,000 (raised from Rs 5,000 in 2018), so Rs 50,000 in statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, PMJDY; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Banking)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY):
1. Loans under Shishu go up to Rs 50,000.
2. Kishore loans cover the range of Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh.
3. MUDRA Ltd lends directly to small borrowers.
4. Loans under PMMY are given without collateral.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Shishu is up to Rs 50,000 and Kishore is Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh (Tarun is Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh), so statement 2 is wrong. MUDRA Ltd is a refinance agency that lends through banks, NBFCs and MFIs, not directly. The loans are collateral-free.
questions.s: PIB, PMMY; MUDRA; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy
questions.h: Shishu = Sapling, Kishore = Growing, Tarun = Mature

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Stand-Up India scheme:
1. It offers bank loans between Rs 1 lakh and Rs 10 lakh.
2. Each bank branch is expected to lend to at least one Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe borrower and at least one woman borrower.
3. The loans are meant for setting up greenfield enterprises.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Stand-Up India (April 2016) supports first-time entrepreneurs from SC/ST and women with loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for greenfield ventures in manufacturing, services or trading. Statement 1 gives the wrong range.
questions.s: PIB, Stand-Up India; SIDBI

questions.q: The Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS) under the Startup India initiative is managed by which one of the following?
o: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
Small Industries Development Bank of India
questions.e: The FFS, with a corpus of Rs 10,000 crore, invests in SEBI-registered alternative investment funds that in turn invest in startups. SIDBI, the apex MSME financier, is its manager.
questions.s: DPIIT, Startup India; SIDBI

questions.q: The Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS), announced in 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat package for MSMEs, provides guarantee coverage through
o: Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India
Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
questions.e: ECLGS gave 100 per cent guarantee coverage to lenders on additional working-capital loans to MSMEs hit by the pandemic, administered by NCGTC. DICGC insures deposits and ECGC covers export credit risk.
questions.s: PIB, Atmanirbhar Bharat package May 2020; NCGTC

questions.q: As per the MSME classification effective 1 April 2025, a medium enterprise is one whose investment in plant and machinery or equipment does not exceed ___ and whose annual turnover does not exceed ___.
questions.e: Budget 2025-26 raised the investment limits by 2.5 times and turnover limits by 2 times: micro Rs 2.5 crore/Rs 10 crore, small Rs 25 crore/Rs 100 crore, medium Rs 125 crore/Rs 500 crore. The Rs 50 crore/Rs 250 crore pair was the 2020 medium limit.
questions.s: Ministry of MSME notification, effective 1 April 2025; Union Budget 2025-26

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the MSME definition introduced in 2020:
1. It retained separate investment limits for manufacturing and service enterprises.
2. Classification is based on a composite criterion of investment and turnover.
3. Registration is done through the Udyam Registration portal.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 2020 revision removed the manufacturing-services distinction and introduced the composite investment-plus-turnover test, with registration on the Udyam portal from 1 July 2020. Statement 1 therefore describes the older 2006 position.
questions.s: Ministry of MSME; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q: The Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE) was set up jointly by the Ministry of MSME and
o: the Industrial Finance Corporation of India
the Small Industries Development Bank of India
the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
questions.e: CGTMSE (2000) guarantees collateral-free credit extended by banks and NBFCs to micro and small enterprises. SIDBI is the Government's partner in the trust.
questions.s: Ministry of MSME; CGTMSE

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP):
1. It merged the earlier Rural Employment Generation Programme and the Prime Minister's Rozgar Yojana.
2. It was launched in 2015 as a part of the Make in India programme.
3. The Khadi and Village Industries Commission is the nodal agency at the national level.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMEGP (2008-09) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for new non-farm micro enterprises, formed by merging REGP and PMRY. It predates Make in India, so statement 2 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of MSME; KVIC

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Scheme)
A. PMEGP
B. SFURTI
C. CGTMSE
D. PM SVANidhi
List-II (Feature)
1. Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro enterprises
2. Cluster-based regeneration of traditional industries
3. Collateral-free credit guarantee for MSE loans
4. Working-capital loans for street vendors
questions.e: PMEGP offers subsidy on new units, SFURTI (Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries) builds clusters of khadi, village and coir artisans, CGTMSE guarantees loans, and PM SVANidhi (2020) gives street vendors small collateral-free loans.
questions.s: Ministry of MSME; MoHUA
questions.h: PMEGP = new units, SFURTI = Clusters, CGTMSE = Guarantee, SVANidhi = Vendors

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes:
1. The first PLI scheme was launched in 2020 for large-scale electronics manufacturing.
2. The incentive is linked to incremental sales of goods manufactured in India over a base year.
3. All PLI schemes are administered by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PLI began in 2020 with mobile phones and electronic components and was extended to 14 sectors, rewarding incremental sales rather than investment. Each scheme is administered by the concerned sectoral ministry, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, PLI schemes; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q: The Semicon India Programme, approved in December 2021 to build a semiconductor and display ecosystem, had an outlay of
questions.e: The programme, under the India Semiconductor Mission in MeitY, offers fiscal support for fabs, display fabs, packaging and design. Rs 6,865 crore is the FPO scheme outlay and Rs 19,744 crore belongs to the Green Hydrogen Mission.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision 15 Dec 2021

questions.q:
Arrange the following schemes in the order of their launch:
1. Make in India
2. Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
3. Startup India
4. Digital India
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: PMJDY was launched on 28 August 2014, Make in India on 25 September 2014, Digital India on 1 July 2015 and Startup India in January 2016.
questions.s: PIB; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy
questions.h: Money first (Jan Dhan), then Make, then Digital, then Start-up

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the UDAY scheme:
1. It aimed at the financial turnaround of electricity distribution companies.
2. States were asked to take over a major part of the DISCOM debt.
3. It was launched by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: UDAY (Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana, 2015) had states take over 75 per cent of DISCOM debt in two years to cut interest burden and enable reforms. It is a Ministry of Power scheme, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Power; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Infrastructure)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Saubhagya scheme was launched in 2014 for last-mile electricity connections.
2. The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana focuses on rural feeder separation and strengthening of distribution networks.
3. The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana subsumed the Rajiv Gandhi Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: DDUGJY (December 2014) took over RGGVY's rural electrification mandate and added feeder separation. Saubhagya came later, in September 2017, to electrify the remaining willing households, so statement 1 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Power; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Infrastructure)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Under the National Monetisation Pipeline, public assets are leased to private parties for a limited period and not sold outright.
Statement-II: The private partner is required to hand the asset back to the Government at the end of the transaction period.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: The NMP (August 2021) targets brownfield assets of the Centre. Because ownership stays with the Government and the asset returns after the lease or concession, it is monetisation and not disinvestment.
questions.s: NITI Aayog, National Monetisation Pipeline, Aug 2021; Union Budget 2021-22

questions.q: The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, launched in October 2021, is built around how many 'engines' of infrastructure?
questions.e: The seven engines are railways, roads, ports, waterways, airports, mass transport and logistics infrastructure. The plan is a GIS-based platform to synchronise projects across ministries.
questions.s: PIB, PM Gati Shakti launch, 13 Oct 2021
questions.h: Seven engines = seven days of the week, all must run

questions.q: The National Green Hydrogen Mission, approved in January 2023, aims to develop green hydrogen production capacity of about
o: 50 million metric tonnes per annum by 2040
5 million metric tonnes per annum by 2030
10 million metric tonnes per annum by 2035
1 million metric tonnes per annum by 2025
questions.e: The Mission, run by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy with an outlay of Rs 19,744 crore, targets 5 MMT a year by 2030, along with the associated renewable capacity.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision, 4 Jan 2023

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding PM-KISAN:
1. It is a Central Sector scheme funded fully by the Union Government.
2. Eligible farmer families receive Rs 6,000 a year in three equal instalments through direct benefit transfer.
3. It is restricted to small and marginal farmers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme began in February 2019 and pays Rs 2,000 three times a year. It was initially restricted to farmers with up to 2 hectares, but was extended to all landholding farmer families in June 2019, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, PM-KISAN; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY):
1. Farmers pay a premium of 2 per cent for kharif food grain and oilseed crops.
2. Enrolment has been voluntary for all farmers since 2020.
3. It covers post-harvest losses for a limited period for specified perils.
4. It excludes losses due to prevented sowing.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The farmer premium is 2 per cent for kharif food grain and oilseeds, 1.5 per cent for rabi and 5 per cent for commercial and horticultural crops. Enrolment became voluntary for all farmers in 2020, and post-harvest losses are covered for up to 14 days. Prevented sowing is covered, so statement 4 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, PMFBY; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Kisan Credit Card (KCC):
1. It was introduced in 2008 on the recommendation of the Swaminathan Commission.
2. The credit limit eligible for interest subvention under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme was raised from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 5 lakh in Budget 2025-26.
3. It was extended to fisheries and animal husbandry farmers in 2018-19.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The KCC dates from 1998 (a NABARD model scheme), not 2008. Budget 2025-26 raised the loan limit for the interest subvention to Rs 5 lakh, and the 2018-19 Budget extended KCC benefits to fisheries and animal husbandry.
questions.s: NABARD; Union Budget 2025-26; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Minimum Support Price is not a legal entitlement of farmers in India.
Statement-II: MSP is announced through an administrative decision of the Government on the recommendation of the CACP and has no statutory backing.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: The CCEA announces MSPs on CACP advice, but no law obliges anyone to buy at MSP; effective procurement depends on government agencies such as FCI and state agencies in specific crops and states. Hence MSP remains a policy commitment, not a legal right.
questions.s: CACP; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding MSP and related price policy:
1. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approves MSPs on the recommendation of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.
2. The CACP is a statutory body created by an Act of Parliament.
3. Sugarcane is priced through a Fair and Remunerative Price and not through MSP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: CACP started in 1965 as the Agricultural Prices Commission and is an attached office of the Agriculture Ministry, not a statutory body. Sugarcane price is the FRP under the Sugarcane (Control) Order, also advised by CACP and approved by CCEA.
questions.s: CACP; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: Under the PM-AASHA umbrella, which component compensates farmers for the difference between the MSP and the price at which they actually sell the produce?
questions.e: PM-AASHA (2018) has three parts: PSS (physical procurement at MSP), PDPS (direct payment of the price difference to farmers) and a pilot PPSS (private agencies procure and stock). In PDPS no physical procurement takes place.
questions.s: PIB, PM-AASHA 2018

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding e-NAM:
1. It is a pan-India electronic trading portal for agricultural commodities launched in April 2016.
2. It is implemented by the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.
3. It networks the existing APMC mandis instead of replacing them.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: e-NAM links mandis into a unified online market with the Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) as the lead implementing agency, not NABARD. It works as a virtual layer over physical mandis.
questions.s: Ministry of Agriculture; SFAC; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: Under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund, interest subvention of 3 per cent per annum is available for loans up to
o: Rs 2 crore for a maximum period of seven years
Rs 5 crore for a maximum period of ten years
Rs 50 lakh for a maximum period of three years
Rs 1 crore for a maximum period of five years
questions.e: The AIF (August 2020) is a Rs 1 lakh crore financing facility for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets such as cold chains and warehouses, with credit guarantee cover for loans up to Rs 2 crore.
questions.s: PIB, Agriculture Infrastructure Fund

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Farmer Producer Organisations help small farmers to get better prices for their produce.
Statement-II: Most farm holdings in India are small and marginal, so individual farmers have little bargaining power and weak access to markets.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Aggregation through an FPO lets small growers pool inputs and produce, cut transaction costs and sell collectively. The Central scheme (2020) targets 10,000 FPOs with support from agencies such as SFAC, NCDC and NABARD.
questions.s: PIB, 10,000 FPO scheme; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Soil Health Card scheme:
1. It was launched in 2015.
2. A card is issued to farmers once in five years.
3. The card indicates the status of soil nutrients and recommended doses of fertilisers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme was launched in February 2015 from Suratgarh, Rajasthan. Cards are issued in a two-year cycle, not five, because soil nutrient status changes with cropping and fertiliser use.
questions.s: Ministry of Agriculture; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a component of the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana?
questions.e: PMKSY (2015) brings together AIBP, Har Khet Ko Pani, watershed development and Per Drop More Crop for micro-irrigation. Rashtriya Gokul Mission is an animal husbandry scheme for indigenous bovine breeds.
questions.s: PIB, PMKSY; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana promotes organic farming mainly through
o: cluster formation and Participatory Guarantee System certification
mandatory third-party NPOP certification for every farmer
state-owned organic farms run by government agencies
individual farmer subsidies for chemical fertilisers
questions.e: PKVY (2015, under the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture) forms clusters of farmers who adopt organic practices together and are certified through PGS-India, a peer-based system suited to small farmers.
questions.s: Ministry of Agriculture; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: The Rashtriya Gokul Mission, launched in 2014, is primarily meant for
o: setting up dairy cooperatives in every village
development and conservation of indigenous bovine breeds
questions.e: The Mission is run by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying to improve productivity and conserve native cattle breeds. Dairy cooperatives belong to the Operation Flood lineage of NDDB.
questions.s: PIB, Rashtriya Gokul Mission

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding fertiliser subsidy:
1. Urea is covered under the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme.
2. The Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme has applied to phosphatic and potassic fertilisers since 2010.
3. Urea is sold at a statutorily notified maximum retail price.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: NBS covers P and K fertilisers from April 2010, with subsidy fixed per nutrient. Urea remains outside it, with a fixed MRP and the Government reimbursing the difference, which is why it is overused relative to P and K.
questions.s: Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Agriculture)

questions.q: The PM-PRANAM scheme approved in 2023 is intended to
o: incentivise States to reduce the use of chemical fertilisers and promote alternative fertilisers
provide crop insurance to organic farmers
fix a minimum support price for natural farming produce
offer loans for setting up solar pumps
questions.e: PM-PRANAM (Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment and Amelioration of Mother Earth) rewards States with a share of the fertiliser subsidy saved when they cut chemical use.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision, June 2023

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana approved by the Cabinet in July 2025:
1. It targets 100 districts with low agricultural productivity, low cropping intensity and below-average credit.
2. Districts are chosen only on the basis of the highest foodgrain production.
3. It is designed around convergence of existing schemes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme (about Rs 24,000 crore a year for six years) picks lagging districts, so statement 2 is the reverse of its logic. It works by converging existing schemes and State programmes.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision, July 2025; Deccan Herald/The Statesman, 16 July 2025

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Scheme)
A. PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
B. PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
C. Atal Pension Yojana
D. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
List-II (Feature)
1. Life cover of Rs 2 lakh for those aged 18 to 50
2. Rs 2 lakh cover on accidental death or total disability
3. Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60
4. Small deposit account for a girl child
questions.e: The first three schemes were launched together on 9 May 2015. PMJJBY is a life term cover, PMSBY an accident cover, and APY (administered by PFRDA) a pension for the unorganised sector. SSY is a girl-child savings scheme under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
questions.s: PIB, 9 May 2015; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Poverty and Social Sectors)
questions.h: 9 May 2015 triple launch: Life, Accident, Pension

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana covers death due to any cause.
2. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana covers accidental death and disability.
3. The entry age for the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is 18 to 70 years.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMJJBY is renewable term life cover for ages 18-50, whereas the 18-70 age band belongs to PMSBY, so statement 3 mixes the two.
questions.s: PIB, 9 May 2015

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana:
1. An account can be opened for a girl child below the age of ten years.
2. The interest rate is fixed for the entire tenure at the time of opening the account.
3. A family can normally open accounts for a maximum of two girl children.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The rate is notified by the Government quarterly and applies to the account balance as it changes, so statement 2 is wrong. The account must be opened before the girl turns ten, and two accounts per family is the norm, with an exception for twins or triplets.
questions.s: Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme:
1. The bonds are denominated in grams of gold.
2. The bonds are issued by the Reserve Bank of India on behalf of the Government of India.
3. Interest on the bonds is paid only on maturity.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: SGBs (introduced in 2015) were designed to cut physical gold imports. They carry a fixed interest (2.5 per cent) paid half-yearly, plus the gold-linked redemption value, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: RBI; Ministry of Finance; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Banking)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Direct Benefit Transfer through the Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile trinity reduces leakages in subsidy delivery.
Statement-II: The trinity links a beneficiary's bank account to a unique identity and mobile number so that payment reaches the right person directly.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Because the money goes straight to a verified account, there are no intermediaries or ghost beneficiaries. The JAM concept was articulated in the Economic Survey 2014-15.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2014-15; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q: Operation Greens, announced in the Union Budget 2018-19, was initially aimed at stabilising the prices of
questions.e: Operation Greens, run by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, started with tomato, onion and potato (TOP) to cut price volatility and post-harvest loss, and was later extended to other perishables.
questions.s: Union Budget 2018-19; PIB, MoFPI

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana is implemented by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
2. The PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme follows a One District One Product approach.
3. The PMFME scheme offers a credit-linked capital subsidy of 35 per cent subject to a ceiling of Rs 10 lakh per unit.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Do not confuse the two PMKSYs: Kisan SAMPADA is the food processing scheme, while Krishi Sinchayee is irrigation. PMFME (2020) supports micro food units with ODOP-based clusters and a 35 per cent subsidy up to Rs 10 lakh.
questions.s: PIB, MoFPI

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Scheme)
A. PM-KUSUM
B. PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana
C. PM Matsya Sampada Yojana
D. Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
List-II (Ministry)
1. Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
2. Ministry of Food Processing Industries
3. Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
4. Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
questions.e: PM-KUSUM promotes solar pumps and solar plants for farmers, hence MNRE. Kisan SAMPADA is food processing, PMMSY is fisheries, and PMFBY crop insurance sits with the Agriculture Ministry.
questions.s: Respective ministries; PIB

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, launched in 2020, primarily seeks to
o: provide crop insurance to inland fish farmers only
compensate farmers for price falls in marine exports
subsidise diesel for all fishing vessels
bring about a Blue Revolution through sustainable development of the fisheries sector
questions.e: PMMSY, with an investment of about Rs 20,050 crore, aims to raise fish production and productivity, build cold chains and improve fishers' incomes. It is more than insurance or fuel support.
questions.s: PIB, PMMSY

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Atal Pension Yojana (APY):
1. It was launched in May 2015.
2. It is open to subscribers between 18 and 40 years of age.
3. The maximum age for joining is 50 years.
4. The Government contributes to the pension account of every subscriber.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: APY (9 May 2015) is administered by PFRDA and guarantees Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month from age 60 for those who join between 18 and 40. Government co-contribution was limited to a specific group and period, not to every subscriber.
questions.s: PFRDA; PIB

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding PM SVANidhi:
1. It was launched in 2020 to provide working-capital loans to street vendors.
2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
3. It is implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM SVANidhi (June 2020) gave street vendors an initial collateral-free loan of Rs 10,000 and rewards timely repayment. It is a MoHUA scheme, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, MoHUA

questions.q: The PM Vishwakarma scheme, launched in September 2023 for artisans and craftspeople, covers how many traditional trades?
questions.e: The scheme gives recognition, skill training, toolkit support and collateral-free credit to artisans in 18 trades such as carpenters, blacksmiths, potters and cobblers.
questions.s: PIB, 17 Sept 2023

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM):
1. It is a flagship initiative of NITI Aayog.
2. It sets up Atal Tinkering Labs in schools.
3. It supports Atal Incubation Centres.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: AIM (2016) promotes innovation from school level (ATLs) to startups (incubation centres), under NITI Aayog.
questions.s: NITI Aayog, AIM

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bharatmala Pariyojana is a road and highway development programme.
2. Sagarmala is a port-led development programme.
3. Both programmes were launched in 2000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Bharatmala (approved 2017) and Sagarmala (2015) are programmes of the last decade, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways; Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY), announced on 15 August 2025:
1. It was earlier introduced as the Employment Linked Incentive scheme.
2. A first-time employee receives the incentive of up to Rs 15,000 in a single payment on joining.
3. Employers are eligible for an incentive for additional employees they hire.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM-VBRY (Rs 1 lakh crore) is the renamed ELI scheme. A first-time employee gets up to one month's wage (cap Rs 15,000) in two instalments, after six and twelve months of employment, and employers get up to Rs 3,000 a month for each added job. So statement 2 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Aug 2025

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Pension System:
1. It was opened to all citizens from 1 January 2004.
2. It was opened to all citizens of India in 2009.
3. A Tier-II account is a voluntary savings account.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: NPS began on 1 January 2004 for central government employees joining on or after that date (except armed forces), and was opened to all citizens in 2009. Tier-II is voluntary. The scheme is regulated by PFRDA.
